title: Clo User Story - Mas
description:
Watch how MAS, a 2-billion-dollar product co-creation partner to some of the world’s leading apparel brands, collaborates with CLO to make Digital Product Creation more connected and meaningful.

#MASUserStory #CLOxMAS #DigitalProductCreation #FashionTech #CLOVirtualFashion #3D
transcript: MSC is a $2 billion global leader in apparel technology, working with some of the most iconic fashion brands to take ideas from concept all the way to the market. At the heart of what we do stands four core values. Innovation, sustainability, co-creation and collaboration. And Clue is one of the essential building blocks that help us reimagine how we develop product. It brings speed and precision into every stage across different business units. So let's take a closer look at how the MSC and Clue partnership is bringing this vision into life. At MSC, product creation begins with research and ideation, diving into consumer insights, trends and market data to understand industry needs and spot gaps in the market. From there, we focus on the consumer sentiment. We focus on making products strategic, innovative and delivering commercially viable products of superior craftsmanship. With that foundation we move into concepting, design and development by tapping into the key tools in our digital toolkit including Clue with its 3D capabilities and generic features. The seamless workflow takes ideas from concept to prototype with precision and agility, Aiding us in visualising digitally and ultimately getting our first physical samples right. Collaboration starts long before a garment is stitched. MAS functions as a centre for product design and innovation for our customers. For us, co-creation is a cycle that starts before the season, continues throughout and even after the season ends. Enabling true product collaboration. With 3D being a universal language for creatives, CLOBE and its suite of tools support our end-to-end workflows that enable connectivity and creative exchange across the calendar. Contributing towards making the right decisions around product in collaboration with our customers. In DPC, material development is where everything begins. Our centralised canning unit has captured over 4,000 fabrics in just two years, supporting more than 50 plus global brands. By capturing texture, stretch, and drape, we create authentic digital twins that bring consistency and precision to every stage of development. With this level of accuracy, we are setting new standards for fabric realism. At MAS, we have been reimagining how lace and warp knits are developed and visualised. Since starting our digital lace journey in 2021, we have made incredible progress with the support of tools like CLOBE. The impact is clear. With our connected ecosystem of tools, including CLOBE, we have made digital sampling over 40% faster. These gains in speed and accuracy are helping us become an even more agile and reliable partner in DPC. Leading the way in advanced knitting, we at MAS have been combining engineered and circular knitting to push the boundaries of what's possible. We were one of the first vendors to enable a fully seamless digital product creation workflow, giving our customers a faster, accurate, more flexible development process. Seamless garment has always been complex and costly, but with digital product creation, we are reducing lead time, cutting costs, and minimising waste. By pairing our knitting expertise with advanced tools like CLOBE and CLOSET, we are innovating a smarter, more efficient, and a sustainable way forward for the industry. To replicate the true-to-life digital twin, we try to mimic graphic techniques digitally like heat seal, foil, and embroidery. These detailed textures are imported into CLOBE, where artwork and patterns are both graded, ensuring precision and reducing errors in the sampling stage. We make full use of CLOBE's specialised tools to create true-to-life digital twins from pressure and stress maps that enhance visual accuracy to building inclusive size sets and evaluating fit across diverse size ranges. While digital garment fit continues to be a challenge across the industry, we continue to explore new approaches and push the boundaries of what's possible in digital product creation. At Emma's, digital colour sampling has transformed the way we work, helping us and our partners look in prints and colourways faster, even with complex fabrics. CLOSET is one of the platforms we use within this workflow. It's a collaborative workplace where we use real-time comments and annotations to streamline feedback and reduce approval cycles. By reviewing designs directly in the platform, decisions are quicker and we stay more responsive to change. At Emma's, digital product creation is more than a process. It's how we bring innovation, creativity, and collaboration to life. We have grown from building the foundations to creating future-ready models that help us and our partners to work smarter. With trusted partners like CLOBE, we are redefining how fashion is created digitally. And as 3D and AI evolve, we stand at the edge of a new era, one that challenges us not only to create faster, but more meaningfully. Together, we are not just shaping the future of fashion, we are shaping the future of possibility. Closed captioning by The Closed Captioning Project
markdown_content: ## Overview of MSC and CLOBE Partnership in Apparel Technology This section introduces MSC, a $2 billion global leader in apparel technology, highlighting its core values: innovation, sustainability, co-creation, and collaboration. It explains how MSC partners with CLOBE to enhance product development processes by integrating 3D capabilities and digital tools, accelerating concept-to-market workflows with precision and agility. MSC collaborates with iconic fashion brands to transform ideas from concept to market. Central to their approach is CLOBE, a digital toolkit that introduces speed and precision at every stage across business units. Product creation begins with research and ideation, focusing on consumer insights, trends, and market data to identify industry needs and market gaps. MSC emphasizes delivering strategic, innovative, commercially viable products with superior craftsmanship. Using CLOBE’s 3D capabilities and generic features, MSC transitions from concept to prototype digitally, allowing accurate visualization and improving the accuracy of first physical samples. Collaboration and co-creation are integral, starting before the season and continuing throughout and beyond, fostering true product collaboration with customers through universal 3D workflows. --- ## Digital Fabric Development and Material Innovation at MSC This section covers MSC’s centralized material development process within its Digital Product Creation (DPC) unit, focusing on fabric digitization, texture capture, and the creation of authentic digital twins. MSC’s DPC team has developed a centralized scanning unit that has digitized over 4,000 fabrics in two years, supporting more than 50 global brands. By capturing fabric texture, stretch, and drape, MSC creates precise digital twins that ensure consistency and accuracy throughout the development cycle. This level of fabric realism sets new industry standards. Since 2021, MSC has been advancing the digital development and visualization of lace and warp knits using CLOBE’s tools. This digital lace journey has significantly increased speed and accuracy, making digital sampling over 40% faster and enhancing agility and reliability within DPC. --- ## Advanced Knitting and Seamless Garment Innovation This section explains MSC’s leadership in advanced knitting techniques, including engineered and circular knitting, and how digital product creation improves seamless garment manufacturing. MSC combines engineered knitting with circular knitting to expand possibilities in fabric and garment design. The company was among the first to implement a fully seamless digital product creation workflow, providing customers faster, more accurate, and flexible product development. Seamless garments traditionally involve complexity and high costs. By leveraging digital product creation tools like CLOBE and CLOSET, MSC reduces lead times, lowers costs, and minimizes waste, contributing to a more sustainable manufacturing model. --- ## Digital Twin Creation: Graphic Techniques and Fit Evaluation This section details how MSC replicates true-to-life digital twins by digitally mimicking graphic techniques and utilizing CLOBE’s specialized tools for enhanced visual accuracy and inclusive fit evaluation. MSC digitally replicates detailed graphics such as heat seal, foil, and embroidery by importing these textures into CLOBE. Artwork and patterns are graded digitally to ensure precision and reduce sampling errors. CLOBE’s specialized tools generate digital twins using pressure and stress maps, enhancing the visual realism of garments. The platform supports building inclusive size sets and evaluating fit across diverse body ranges. Despite ongoing challenges in digital garment fit industry-wide, MSC continues to innovate and explore new methods to improve digital product creation. --- ## Digital Color Sampling and Collaborative Workflow with CLOSET This section discusses MSC’s use of digital color sampling and the CLOSET platform to accelerate design decisions and streamline feedback in the product development cycle. MSC leverages digital color sampling to quickly assess prints and colorways, even on complex fabrics. CLOSET serves as a collaborative workspace where real-time comments and annotations facilitate faster feedback and reduce approval cycles. Design reviews occur directly within CLOSET, enabling quicker decisions and increased responsiveness to changes. This collaborative approach enhances innovation, creativity, and operational efficiency within MSC and its partners. --- ## Future of Fashion with Digital Product Creation and AI This concluding section reflects on how MSC, with partners like CLOBE, is redefining fashion through digital product creation and anticipates the evolving role of 3D and AI technologies. MSC’s digital product creation process has evolved from foundational development to future-ready models that empower smarter workflows. Partnering with CLOBE, MSC is pioneering new standards in digital fashion creation. As 3D and AI technologies advance, MSC embraces a new era focused not only on speed but meaningful innovation, shaping the future possibilities of the fashion industry.
